name: Gasthaus Karlsteg
kurzbeschreibung:
**Inn Karlsteg in Finkenberg**

Welcome to **Inn Karlsteg**, a cozy and traditional guesthouse nestled in the heart of **Finkenberg**, a charming village in the **Tirol** Alps. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this family-run establishment offers warm hospitality and authentic Tyrolean charm.

Enjoy hearty **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Kaspressknödel**, and fresh mountain trout, all prepared with local ingredients. The rustic wooden interiors and crackling fireplaces create a welcoming atmosphere year-round.

Whether you're seeking relaxation after a day of hiking in the **Zillertal** or a peaceful retreat, **Inn Karlsteg** promises a genuine alpine experience. Come and unwind in the embrace of the **Tirol** mountains!
